summary: Global-Smart.Tech Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that CEO and principal shareholder Yehor Rodin voluntarily surrendered 3,000,000 shares of common stock for cancellation at zero consideration. The board accepted the surrender, reducing outstanding shares from 6,134,780 to 3,134,780. No premium, date, or advisors were mentioned. The shares revert to authorized but unissued status, and authorized shares remain unchanged. This is a non-cash capital return via share cancellation. Watch for any follow-up capital allocation plans or liquidity events.
